info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Hazel Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Management API allows retailers to efficiently add detailed descriptions for products, specifically designed for the Hazel Jacket. This endpoint enables the submission of comprehensive product information, ensuring that the catalog is up-to-date and accurately represents the offerings. Common consumers of this API include eCommerce platforms and inventory management systems, which use it to enhance their product listings and improve customer engagement. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline their product catalog processes and maintain competitive listings.
